review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that art galleries and museums gradually become useless due to the proliferation of technology. Personally, I am to refute this school of thought.

Admittedly, technology offers flexible culture experience ways. Initially, digital brings many advantages, including high-resolution images; three-dimensional reconstruction; virtual reality platform which enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail whenever and wherever. This can be seen in the way Louvre Museum, renowing the biggest museum in the world, offering a wide range of virtual reality platforms to allow art lovers can pay a visit regardless distance. Therefore, those cannot afford and have mobility issues could be still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I believe that public museums and art galleries still remain integral part of society. Firstly, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person, thus evoking emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. For example, though soldiers' uniform displayed at war museum we can easily immerse in the resistance period and be grateful with suffering society of soldier. Furthermore, museum and galleries attached with vital cultural hubs, thereby symbolizing the identity of a region. Ultimately, becoming a magnet for tourism and fostering a facilitator of bonding within the community.
In conclusion, although benefits of technology should to not cannot be refute, public museums and art galleries still play a pivotal role due to these signature advantages.

completion.comment: Bài có mở bài, hai thân bài và kết bài.

review.overall: Em giữ đúng lập trường bảo vệ bảo tàng sau khi thừa nhận lợi ích công nghệ; ví dụ quân phục thời chiến là chi tiết riêng có thể làm rõ trải nghiệm trực tiếp. Tuy nhiên, mức tự soát cấu trúc còn yếu. Mở bài mới nói chung về công nghệ, chưa nêu việc xem hiện vật trên máy tính. Body 1 và kết bài có nhiều cụm chưa thành câu đúng, nhất là 'offering ... to allow ... can', 'could be still access' và 'should to not cannot be refute'. Em cần nghiêm túc viết lại từng câu, nối ví dụ quân phục với sự chân thực và soát động từ trước khi nộp.

paragraphs: It is argued that people can view historical objects and works of art on a computer, making art galleries and museums unnecessary in the future. Personally, I refute this school of thought.

Admittedly, technology offers flexible ways to experience culture and history. Initially, digital technology brings many advantages, including high-resolution images; three-dimensional reconstruction; virtual reality platforms which enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artefacts in remarkable detail at any time and from any place. This can be seen in the way the Louvre Museum, a renowned museum, offers online tours that allow art lovers to explore its collections from a distance. Therefore, people who cannot afford a museum visit or have mobility issues can still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I believe that public museums and art galleries still remain an integral part of society. Firstly, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person. Seeing one in person can evoke emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. For example, a soldier's uniform displayed in a war museum helps visitors imagine the resistance period and appreciate the soldiers' sacrifices. Furthermore, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs, thereby symbolizing the identity of a region. It naturally follows that they can attract tourists and facilitate bonding within the community.
In conclusion, although the benefits of technology cannot be denied, public museums and art galleries still play a pivotal role thanks to the direct experience and cultural value they offer.

nextSteps: Viết lại câu Louvre bằng một động từ chính offers và khung allow someone to do something.
Nối ví dụ quân phục với cảm xúc khi gặp hiện vật thật, rồi viết trọn câu kết quả du lịch.
Nghiêm túc soát kết bài: chọn một phủ định, bỏ should to và dùng dạng bị động đúng sau be; đối chiếu từng câu đã sửa với bản gốc.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
